copy.heading: A weekend without a court
copy.instructions: Try one full weekend without booking a court. Tick each thing you did instead.

items: Took Mia to the park on Saturday morning, and stayed until she wanted to go home.
Did bath time on both nights.
Went to the big shop with the buggy in the boot.
Had lunch with your mum and dad, and nobody mentioned glass walls.
Watched a film with Lauren and did not check the group chat during it.
Let Alfie crawl around the garden without assessing his footwork.
Went to bed on Sunday without booking Monday.
